chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Looking at ʿAlī عليه السلام is an act of worship."

key_terms.النَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the speaker of this hadith
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: Imam ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام
key_terms.عِبَادَةٌ: an act of worship and devotion to Allah

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean that looking at Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام is worship?
ai.summary: This hadith states that looking at Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام is itself an act of worship. It expresses the lofty spiritual rank and sanctified status of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام in the Prophetic tradition.
